channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: FBI investigating after hackers say they took sensitive data from agency's jobs site
item.description: The FBI is investigating criminal hackers' claims of breaching its jobs website. The apparent hack poses a potential counterintelligence risk and a safety concern for employees and applicants.

item.title: Farmers face big expenses and an uncertain bottom line during fall harvest season
item.description: As the fall harvest gets underway, many farmers are in the red. While crop prices have improved somewhat since last year, operating costs have increased, led by record high diesel prices.

item.title: New research suggests human actions could be driving increase in disease outbreaks
item.description: Infectious disease outbreaks are on the rise worldwide. A new analysis finds human actions, from deforestation to climate change, are partly responsible.

item.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for assault
item.description: More than six years after his first trial began, former movie mogul Harvey Weinstein's New York sex crimes case came to a close Wednesday when he was sentenced to 15 years in prison.

item.title: 'Nerd Heaven'? George Lucas's new museum opens, but it's not just about 'Star Wars'
item.description: The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opened Tuesday in Los Angeles – a $1 billion "temple to the people's art" courtesy of Star Wars creator George Lucas.
